faqs.a: In our workshop at Unit 1, Merrywell Business Park, Drumree, Co. Meath. Our own joiners fit it.

faqs.q: Can you design it for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Joinery design, including 3D views, is part of our design service. We can also work from your designer's drawings.

faqs.q: Do you make joinery for businesses?
faqs.a: Yes. We designed and built the reception, waiting areas and joinery for a clinic in Dublin 1.

faqs.q: Can you build storage into the eaves of an attic?
faqs.a: Yes. We have built eaves wardrobes and dressing rooms in attic conversions in Rathcoole.

faqs.q: Do you work in my area?
faqs.a: We work within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath. That covers all of Dublin and towns in Meath, Kildare, Louth (such as Drogheda) and north Wicklow.
